startup_bss_clear.startup_path: 0x00000000 branches to 0x0000012C; 0x00000398 branches to 0x00004438; 0x00004438 calls 0x000071AC then clears BSS
startup_bss_clear.effect: word-wise zero stores cover word 0x193EC containing byte 0x193ED before later code

partition_attribute_branch.pl_branch: 0x00000B80 TST fp,#0x20; nonzero falls through 0xB98; 0xB94 BEQ 0xBB4 takes non-PL path
partition_attribute_branch.pl_flag_set_instruction: 0x00000BAC: STRB r2,[r4,#0x391] after r2=1 on PL path
partition_attribute_branch.ps_path: 0x00000BB4 tests bit 0x10; stores other context bytes at 0x193EB/0x193EE/0x193EC, with no store to 0x193ED
partition_attribute_branch.static_image_path_conclusion: all three BOOT.BIN partition attributes have bit 0x20 clear; on the normal parser path none takes the PL flag-set path, so flag remains 0 after reset and partition scan (INFERRED static control-flow result; not target execution)

handoff_branch.zero_branch: 0x000012E4 BNE 0x00001350 is not taken when flag is 0; flow skips post-config call and continues at 0x000012E8
handoff_branch.post_config_branch: 0x00001350 BL 0x00002C48 is reached only via the nonzero branch at 0x12E4
handoff_branch.handoff_transfer: on the nonzero handoff-address path, 0x00001334 BL 0x000103E0; helper 0x103E0 copies r0 to LR and transfers with BX LR at 0x10400. The binary checks r4 at 0x1310/0x1320 and takes a separate zero-address path; BOOT header gives U-Boot execution address 0x04000000 but does not prove LoadBootImage returned it at runtime.

addressed_machine_code_evidence.fact: STRB r3,[r4,#0x391]; r4=0x1905C and r3=0 at this point, so store byte zero at 0x193ED
BEQ 0xBB4 routes bit-0x20-clear partitions away from PL flag-set block
STRB r2,[r4,#0x391]; on PL path r2 was set to 1
PS path tests bit 0x10; its stores do not target 0x193ED
calls early CPU/MMU setup before BSS clear loop
zero-word store and post-increment in first BSS-clear range
zero-word store and post-increment in second BSS-clear range
BNE 0x1350 gates handoff-time post-config on nonzero flag
BL 0x103E0 uses nonzero handoff address after zero-flag path

jtag_branch.bootmode_dispatch: 0x000101C4 loads BOOT_MODE, masks low 3 bits; selector table at 0x101E0 maps value 0 to 0x102E8
jtag_branch.machine_test: 0x000102F0 loads 0xF800700C; 0x000102F4 TST bit 0x4; 0x000102F8 BNE 0x103A4 calls 0x2C48 there and rejoins at 0x102FC; clear bit skips that call
jtag_branch.interpretation: SDK template labels selector 0 JTAG and bit 0x4 PCFG_DONE; template association only, and runtime boot mode/PCFG_DONE are UNKNOWN

evidence_classes.MACHINE_CODE_FACT: instruction words and control-flow targets decoded from the raw payload at base 0
evidence_classes.IMAGE_HEADER_FACT: partition attributes and execution addresses parsed from local BOOT.BIN analysis
evidence_classes.INFERRED: BitstreamFlag/FsblHandoff/LoadBootImage names, partition attribute semantics, and normal-path outcome based on static inputs plus SDK template cross-reference
evidence_classes.UNKNOWN: whether this BOOT image ever executed, actual runtime flag/MMIO values, alternate boot image or mutated partition headers, aliases through unrelated runtime pointers, and selected U-Boot environment

dtb.rendering: readable DTS-like text; scalar arrays use big-endian 32-bit cells; unclassified non-cell data uses bytes

relevant_fpga_register_nodes.search_interpretation: FDT names, property names and printable property values only; an absent AFI label does not prove absence of runtime register writes

uboot_env.report_scope: exact boot/FPGA/AFI allowlist; other environment variables deliberately omitted
uboot_env.possible_register_initialization: UNKNOWN: BootGen analysis contains no BootROM init pairs; decoded FSBL table addresses are enumerated separately; U-Boot default strings do not prove runtime MMIO behavior, and this audit does not establish absence of all code-driven or indirect U-Boot writes.

limitations: Header image_name says zynq_fsbl.elf, but raw extracted payload begins with ARM branch instructions and lacks ELF magic; do not treat the image name as ELF/source identity.
SDK source excerpts are installed 2026.1 reference templates and not proven to be the source of this raw image.
Static analysis only: no target execution, board, SSH, MMIO, mount, or hardware-state claim.
Full indirect write behavior outside decoded table commands is not proven absent.
